entities.summary: Despić House is an old merchant house in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina that was established in 1881 by one of the wealthiest and most prominent Serb families in Sarajevo. It is a branch of the Museum of Sarajevo. Despić House is a museum in Europe, established in 1881. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
